description: This file defines a Java interface for the FloatingRateRepository, which extends Spring Data JPA repository interfaces to provide database access methods for FloatingRate entities, including custom query methods to retrieve base lending rates and linked floating rates.

classes.name: FloatingRateRepository
classes.description: A Spring Data JPA repository interface for managing FloatingRate entities, with custom queries for fetching specific floating rate data.

methods.name: retrieveBaseLendingRate
methods.description: Fetches the active base lending rate from the database.

methods.name: retrieveFloatingRatesLinkedToBLR
methods.description: Retrieves active floating rates that are linked to the base lending rate.
